name: Echo CS-4010
blurb: A 41.6 cc saw: 18″ bars on 3/8″ low-profile chain, .050″ gauge, 62 drive links per Echo's own chart.
intro: The Echo CS-4010 is a 41.6 cc saw. Echo lists an 18″ bar for the CS-4010 on 3/8″ low-profile .050″ chain — the same chain family as the smaller CS-310 and CS-352, just a longer loop.

bars.note: Echo bar 18A0CD3762C; chain 91PX62CQ. Echo’s specification table lists 18″ as the bar length for this saw.

sources.title: ECHO chainsaws catalog (Jan 2023) — “Bars and Chains” chart: bar and chain part numbers, drive-link count, gauge, pitch and file size per saw; saw specification tables
